must_fix.issue: Intro reads as a dodge against the title. must_fix.fix: Soften the tension in the first 100 words: say plainly that this guide does not quote a figure because each planner sets their own, and that it shows how to get a fee in writing you can compare. Move the ways a planner may charge (a flat fee, a percentage of the trip, supplier commissions, or a mix) into the intro or the second takeaway (line 17) as things to ask, not as claims. Keep 'A number on its own tells you very little.' only if it now reads as a promise, not a refusal. NO FIGURES, no ranges, nothing about how Wedded Wonderland charges.

Requests for Wedded Wonderland fee basis, commissions, insolvency cover, after-hours contact, a phone call first, discretion and scale proof (planner_couple, funding_parent, sceptic, uhnw): deferred to the business, not actioned in copy.
